correctness.rationale: The Gauss sum and additive-Fourier calculation gives exact real and imaginary mean-zero Hessian eigenvalues 3-6/q+12/q^2 and 3-6/q in normalized L2. The published global sharp extension theorem bounds all mixed sixth-moment terms by 46 C_q r^3, and q>=5 establishes 46C_q/64< (3-6/q)/2. Standalone numerical tests passed 1069 assertions across five fields including q=25; the general proof is symbolic, not extrapolated from those tests.
